requirement_text: Memory alignment shall take no more than 1 second per Megabyte of data to be realigned.
requirement_text_raw: Memory alignment shall [SRS203] take no more than 1 second per Megabyte of data to be realigned.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want memory alignment to take no more than 1 second per Megabyte of data realigned, so that realignment time is bounded.
technical_task: Bound the memory alignment time to at most 1 second for each Megabyte of data being realigned.
acceptance_criteria: Given data to be realigned, when memory alignment runs, then it takes no more than 1 second per Megabyte.
Given a larger amount of data, when memory alignment runs, then the allowed time grows in proportion to the number of Megabytes.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The proportional criterion follows from the per-Megabyte limit.

requirement_text: The user ID and date or time stamp shall be recorded.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the user ID and a date or time stamp recorded, so that actions can be attributed.
technical_task: Record the user ID together with a date or time stamp for the audited action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user performs an audited action, when the action is saved, then the user ID is recorded.
Given a user performs an audited action, when the action is saved, then a date or time stamp is recorded.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. Which actions are covered is not stated.

requirement_text: The prototype NEs shall use convection cooling.
requirement_text_raw: The prototype NEs shall (3.2.3.1.1.5) use convection cooling.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the prototype NEs to use convection cooling, so that they do not need forced cooling.
technical_task: Design the cooling of the prototype NEs around convection.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prototype NE, when its cooling design is reviewed, then it uses convection cooling.
Given a prototype NE in operation, when its cooling is inspected, then no other cooling method is relied on.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "shall use".

requirement_text: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the system to read initialization data to find out the heating and cooling units, so that it knows which equipment exists.
technical_task: At start, read initialization data and derive the definitions of the heating and cooling units from it.
acceptance_criteria: Given initialization data, when the system starts, then it reads the data.
Given the data read, when the system initializes, then the definitions of heating and cooling units are derived from it.
rationale: Role assumed: building manager.

requirement_text: User shall have access to continuous power to ensure uninterrupted operation.
rationale: The sentence puts a power supply on the user and gives no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is the system supposed to provide power, or is this a requirement on the user's environment?
What does "continuous power" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: System shall allow users to reset their passwords through a user-friendly and secure method. It should include verifying identity through security questions or sending verification codes to the registered email or phone number.
user_story: As a user who forgot my password, I want to reset it by verifying my identity, so that I can regain access securely.
technical_task: Provide a password reset that verifies identity through security questions or verification codes sent to the registered email or phone number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the user answers the security questions correctly, then the user can set a new password.
Given a user requests a password reset, when a verification code is sent to the registered email or phone number and entered correctly, then the user can set a new password.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "User-friendly" is not measured.

requirement_text: System shall display an error message and return the cash card if the account has insufficient funds.
user_story: As a cardholder, I want an error message and my cash card returned when the account has insufficient funds, so that I know why the transaction failed.
technical_task: Show an error message and eject the cash card when the account balance is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with insufficient funds, when the cardholder attempts a transaction, then an error message is displayed.
Given an account with insufficient funds, when the error message is shown, then the cash card is returned.
rationale: Role assumed: cardholder.

requirement_text: The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'
user_story: As a facility manager, I want the system to serve 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm, so that staff can work at the same time.
technical_task: Support 10 simultaneous users between 9am and 5pm.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10 users are connected between 9am and 5pm, when they use the system at the same time, then the system serves all of them.
Given the working window of 9am to 5pm, when the number of simultaneous users is 10, then the system continues to respond.
rationale: Role assumed: facility manager.

requirement_text: The sensor must not miss an object that changed its movement category from Moving to Accident for longer than 1 sensor cycle after the initial 4 sensor cycles after the accident, where a miss is an undelivered sensor object.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor not to miss an object that changed its movement category from Moving to Accident for longer than 1 sensor cycle after the initial 4 sensor cycles, so that accident objects are tracked.
technical_task: Ensure the sensor delivers an object that changed from Moving to Accident, allowing a miss (an undelivered sensor object) of no longer than 1 sensor cycle after the initial 4 sensor cycles following the accident.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object changes from Moving to Accident, when 4 sensor cycles after the accident have passed, then the sensor does not miss the object for longer than 1 sensor cycle.
Given the sensor does not deliver the object, when this is counted, then it is counted as a miss.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer. A miss is defined in the requirement as an undelivered sensor object.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall keep a minor frame count from 0 to 49.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS025] keep a minor frame count from 0 to 49.
user_story: As a software engineer, I want the scheduler to keep a minor frame count from 0 to 49, so that frames are numbered consistently.
technical_task: Maintain a minor frame counter in the scheduler that runs from 0 up to 49.
acceptance_criteria: Given the scheduler is running, when a minor frame starts, then the minor frame count is between 0 and 49.
Given the count has reached 49, when the next minor frame starts, then the count returns to 0.
rationale: Role assumed: software engineer. The wrap-around is an interpretation of a count from 0 to 49.

requirement_text: Data queries from the Presentation or the Business Logic layers shall be validated for appropriate use of query language and validated for appropriate quantity and quality of data input.
requirement_text_raw: Data queries from the Presentation or the Business Logic layers shall be validated for appropriate use of query language  and validated for appropriate quantity and quality of data input.
user_story: As a security engineer, I want data queries from the Presentation or Business Logic layers validated for query language use and for the quantity and quality of data input, so that bad queries are blocked.
technical_task: Validate every data query coming from the Presentation or Business Logic layers for appropriate use of the query language and for appropriate quantity and quality of input data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data query from the Presentation or the Business Logic layer, when it is received, then its use of the query language is validated.
Given a data query from either layer, when it is received, then the quantity and quality of its data input are validated.
rationale: Role assumed: security engineer. What counts as appropriate is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain consistent security through the use of passwords.
user_story: As a user, I want security to be maintained through the use of passwords, so that only I can access my account.
technical_task: Protect access with passwords as the security mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a password, when the user enters the correct password, then access is granted.
Given a user, when the user enters a wrong password, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Consistent" is read as passwords being required everywhere.

requirement_text: The system captures the reason for the "refill push" and the pharmacist requesting the refill.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want the reason for a refill push and the pharmacist requesting the refill captured, so that refill requests can be understood later.
technical_task: Capture the reason for each refill push and the pharmacist who requests the refill.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refill push, when it is made, then its reason is captured.
Given a refill request, when it is made, then the requesting pharmacist is captured.
rationale: Role stated: pharmacist.

requirement_text: The system shall be accessible to users both from within the application and through a web browser interface.
user_story: As a user, I want to use the system from within the application or through a web browser, so that I can choose how to reach it.
technical_task: Offer access both inside the application and through a web browser interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when a user opens the system there, then the system is accessible.
Given a web browser, when a user opens the web interface, then the system is accessible.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The product shall be able to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch. This number will increase to 20 000 by Release 2.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be able to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch.  This number will increase to 20 000 by Release 2.'
user_story: As a business owner, I want the product to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch and 20 000 by Release 2, so that capacity grows with the business.
technical_task: Size the product for 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of launch, rising to 20 000 by Release 2.
acceptance_criteria: Given two years after launch, when the product is under load, then it processes 10 000 transactions per hour.
Given Release 2, when the product is under load, then it processes 20 000 transactions per hour.
rationale: Role assumed: business owner.

requirement_text: It shall be possible to reassign a task to a different rate group as a function of the mission mode.
requirement_text_raw: It shall (3.3.4.6) be possible to reassign a task to a different rate group as a function of the mission mode.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want to reassign a task to a different rate group depending on the mission mode, so that scheduling fits the mode.
technical_task: Allow a task's rate group to be changed according to the current mission mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task in a rate group, when the mission mode changes, then the task can be reassigned to a different rate group.
Given a mission mode, when a task is reassigned, then the task runs in its new rate group.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: FABS user shall have validations run in a reasonable amount of time.
rationale: "A reasonable amount of time" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: How long is "a reasonable amount of time" for a validation run?
Which validations does this apply to?

requirement_text: For details see [PLGW_R-109] chapter "Setting of SCC installation flag" [SCC-5674].
rationale: The sentence only points to other documents and states no requirement.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced chapter specify?
Is the referenced content part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall comply with insurance regulations regarding claims processing.'
user_story: As a claims manager, I want the product to comply with insurance regulations on claims processing, so that claims are handled lawfully.
technical_task: Check the claims processing flow against the applicable insurance regulations and implement what they require.
acceptance_criteria: Given the claims processing flow, when it is reviewed against the insurance regulations, then it complies with them.
Given a claim, when it is processed, then the steps required by the insurance regulations are performed.
rationale: Role assumed: claims manager. The regulations are not named.

requirement_text: System shall provide real-time price updates.
user_story: As a trader, I want price updates in real time, so that I see current prices.
technical_task: Push price updates to the display as they happen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a price changes, when the change occurs, then the displayed price is updated.
Given the price display is open, when several updates arrive, then each is shown without a manual refresh.
rationale: Role assumed: trader. "Real-time" is not quantified.

requirement_text: Upon successful login, the user shall be able to browse the catalogue, search for items, or navigate to the Videos and Contact Us sections.
user_story: As a customer, I want to browse the catalogue, search for items or open the Videos and Contact Us sections after logging in, so that I can reach what I need.
technical_task: After a successful login, offer catalogue browsing, item search and navigation to the Videos and Contact Us sections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when the user lands on the next page, then browsing the catalogue is available.
Given a successful login, when the user looks at the options, then searching for items and navigating to Videos and Contact Us are available.
rationale: Role assumed: customer.

requirement_text: The offset error of the EgoLane to the driven trajectory shall not be larger than the offset error of the DTR_LaneRadius to the driven trajectory within 90 % of the time period.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the EgoLane offset error to the driven trajectory never to exceed that of the DTR_LaneRadius within 90 % of the time period, so that EgoLane is at least as accurate.
technical_task: Verify that the offset error of the EgoLane to the driven trajectory is not larger than that of the DTR_LaneRadius within 90 % of the time period.
acceptance_criteria: Given a time period, when both offset errors are measured, then the EgoLane error is not larger than the DTR_LaneRadius error within 90 % of the period.
Given the EgoLane error exceeds the DTR_LaneRadius error for longer than the allowed part of the period, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer.

requirement_text: The details on the SCO module integration process shall be agreed on between the contractor and client during a workshop upon project start.
rationale: The sentence describes a project agreement, not a behaviour of the system.
clarification_questions: What details of the SCO module integration process are to be agreed?
What must the system provide, as opposed to what the contractor and client agree?

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to manage tournaments by creating a unique ID for each new tournament, scheduling matches, and conducting one tournament at a time.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage tournaments by creating a unique ID for each one, scheduling matches and running one tournament at a time, so that tournaments don't overlap.
technical_task: Provide tournament management that generates a unique ID per new tournament, schedules matches and allows only one tournament to be conducted at a time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new tournament, when the admin creates it, then it gets a unique ID.
Given a tournament in progress, when the admin tries to conduct another at the same time, then it is not allowed.
rationale: Role stated: admin.

requirement_text: The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.
requirement_text_raw: The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case.  This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'
user_story: As a dispute manager, I want the Disputes application to keep a detailed history of every user action on a dispute case, so that a complete audit trail exists.
technical_task: Record each action a user takes on a dispute case and keep the full history for audit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user acts on a dispute case, when the action is completed, then it is added to the case history.
Given a dispute case, when questions arise later, then the history shows every action taken on it.
rationale: Role assumed: dispute manager.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the manager homepage after login.
user_story: As a manager, I want to open the manager homepage after logging in, so that I reach my tools.
technical_task: Direct a user who logs in to the manager homepage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager logs in, when login succeeds, then the manager homepage can be accessed.
Given a user without manager rights logs in, when login succeeds, then the manager homepage is not accessible.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. The second criterion is an assumption about who may see the page.

requirement_text: Details of the end of line alignment process depending on the component have to be agreed with OEM development and production.
rationale: The sentence says details must be agreed with others and states no component behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which details of the end of line alignment process need to be agreed?
What must the component or process do?

requirement_text: User shall be able to select their availability (employee function).
user_story: As an employee, I want to select my availability, so that I can be scheduled when I am free.
technical_task: Add an availability selection for the employee function.
acceptance_criteria: Given the employee function, when an employee selects their availability, then it is saved.
Given a saved availability, when the employee views it, then the selection is shown.
rationale: Role stated: employee.

requirement_text: The System shall meet all applicable accounting standards. The final version of the System must successfully pass independent audit performed by a certified auditor.
requirement_text_raw: The System shall meet all applicable accounting standards.  The final version of the System must successfully pass independent audit performed by a certified auditor.'
user_story: As a finance director, I want the system to meet all applicable accounting standards and pass an independent audit by a certified auditor, so that its books can be trusted.
technical_task: Check the system against all applicable accounting standards and have the final version audited by a certified auditor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the applicable accounting standards, when the system is reviewed, then it meets all of them.
Given the final version of the system, when an independent audit by a certified auditor is performed, then the system passes it.
rationale: Role assumed: finance director. The standards are not named.

requirement_text: Upon tapping a specific date, the calendar shall display detailed descriptions in the lower screen section.
user_story: As a user, I want detailed descriptions in the lower screen section when I tap a date, so that I can see what is planned.
technical_task: Show detailed descriptions in the lower part of the screen when a calendar date is tapped.
acceptance_criteria: Given the calendar, when the user taps a specific date, then detailed descriptions are displayed in the lower screen section.
Given a date with nothing planned, when the user taps it, then no descriptions are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: System shall be able to read device information and initiate the authorization process.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to read my device information and start authorization, so that I can be granted access.
technical_task: Read device information and trigger the authorization process.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device, when the system reads its information, then the device information is available to the system.
Given the device information has been read, when the system proceeds, then the authorization process is started.
rationale: Role assumed: user.

requirement_text: The sensor shall calculate the standard deviation of the estimated distance to the road border and report a correction value for which the reported distance to the road border may be larger.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the sensor to compute the standard deviation of the estimated distance to the road border and report a correction value, so that the distance is known with its uncertainty.
technical_task: Compute the standard deviation of the estimated distance to the road border and report a correction value by which the reported distance may be larger.
acceptance_criteria: Given estimates of the distance to the road border, when the sensor processes them, then it calculates their standard deviation.
Given the standard deviation, when the sensor reports, then it includes a correction value for which the reported distance may be larger.
rationale: Role assumed: driver assistance engineer.

requirement_text: In the calendar the date entry with a prescription date (i.e. the date of the office visit the medication was prescribed on) shall display a label for the medications prescribed (i.e. NDC see Data Format 6.6) in the prescription.
requirement_text_raw: In the calendar  the date entry with a prescription date (i.e.  the date of the office visit the medication was prescribed on) shall display a label for the medications prescribed (i.e.  NDC  see Data Format 6.6) in the prescription.
user_story: As a patient, I want a prescription date on my calendar to show a label for the medications prescribed at that visit, so that I know which medications were prescribed.
technical_task: Display on the calendar entry of a prescription date a label listing the medications prescribed in that prescription (by NDC, see Data Format 6.6).
acceptance_criteria: Given a date that is a prescription date, when the calendar is displayed, then the date entry shows a label for the medications prescribed.
Given a prescription, when the label is shown, then it identifies the medications by NDC as in Data Format 6.6.
rationale: Role assumed: patient.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that each doctor is mapped to one and only one specialty.
user_story: As a hospital administrator, I want each doctor mapped to exactly one specialty, so that doctors are listed consistently.
technical_task: Enforce a one-to-one mapping between a doctor and a specialty.
acceptance_criteria: Given a doctor, when the doctor is saved, then the doctor is mapped to one specialty.
Given a doctor who already has a specialty, when a second specialty is assigned, then the assignment is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: hospital administrator.

requirement_text: The system shall provide summarized and detailed reports on user access usage logs etc.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall provide summarized and detailed reports on user access  usage logs  etc.
user_story: As an administrator, I want summarized and detailed reports on user access and usage logs, so that I can review activity.
technical_task: Produce summary reports and detailed reports based on user access and usage logs.
acceptance_criteria: Given usage logs, when the administrator requests a summary report, then summarized information is shown.
Given usage logs, when the administrator requests a detailed report, then detailed information is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Etc." means other logs may be included; they are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall experience smooth and efficient translation requests handling, even during concurrent usage, facilitated by effective concurrency control mechanisms.
rationale: "Smooth", "efficient" and "effective" are not measurable and no concurrency level is given.
clarification_questions: What counts as "smooth and efficient" handling of translation requests?
How many concurrent users must be supported?

requirement_text: System administration shall be performed using a different username than the one used for daily non-administrative activities.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want to use a different username for administration than for daily non-administrative work, so that admin rights are separate.
technical_task: Require administrators to perform system administration under a username separate from their daily account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person who administers the system, when the person performs administration, then a username different from the daily one is used.
Given the daily non-administrative username, when the person tries to administer the system with it, then the action is not allowed.
rationale: Role stated: system administration.

requirement_text: System shall run on devices with less than 1GB RAM.
user_story: As a user with an older device, I want the system to run on devices with less than 1GB RAM, so that I don't need new hardware.
technical_task: Make the system run on devices that have less than 1GB of RAM.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device with less than 1GB RAM, when the system is started, then it runs.
Given a device with less than 1GB RAM, when the system is used, then it keeps working.
rationale: Role assumed: user with an older device.

requirement_text: Click 'Add' and select "Referral" from the drop-down list to begin a new Referral transaction.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to click Add and pick Referral from a drop-down list to begin a referral transaction, so that I can start a referral.
technical_task: Offer an Add button with a drop-down that includes Referral and starts a new Referral transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given the screen, when the user clicks Add, then a drop-down list is shown that contains Referral.
Given the drop-down list, when the user selects Referral, then a new Referral transaction begins.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician.

requirement_text: System shall adhere to usability standards outlined by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) for intuitive and user-friendly interface design.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to follow the W3C usability standards, so that it is intuitive and user-friendly.
technical_task: Design the interface to adhere to the usability standards outlined by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).
acceptance_criteria: Given the interface, when it is reviewed against the W3C usability standards, then it adheres to them.
Given the interface design, when a reviewer checks it, then it follows the W3C guidance.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which W3C documents apply is not stated.

requirement_text: The timestamps shall be frozen during TNR until the realignment is complete.
requirement_text_raw: The timestamps shall (3.2.2.7.9) be frozen during TNR until the realignment is complete.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timestamps frozen during TNR until realignment completes, so that time stays consistent.
technical_task: Hold the timestamps constant during TNR until the realignment is complete.
acceptance_criteria: Given TNR is in progress, when the timestamps are read, then they do not change.
Given the realignment completes, when TNR ends, then the timestamps resume.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. Resuming is an interpretation of "until".

requirement_text: User shall have access to a well-defined incident response plan and incident management procedures within the app to handle security incidents effectively, minimizing their impact.
rationale: "Well-defined", "effectively" and "minimizing" are not measurable and the content is not specified.
clarification_questions: What must the incident response plan and procedures contain?

requirement_text: The system shall be able to perform periodic backups.
user_story: As an administrator, I want periodic backups, so that data can be restored if something fails.
technical_task: Schedule backups to run periodically.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backup schedule, when the scheduled time arrives, then a backup is performed.
Given a completed backup, when an administrator checks it, then the backup is available.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The period is not specified.

requirement_text: Databases shall be protected by username and password authentication.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want databases protected by username and password authentication, so that only authorized users connect.
technical_task: Require username and password authentication for access to the databases.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when a user connects to a database, then access is granted.
Given invalid credentials, when a user connects to a database, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator.

requirement_text: The system shall maintain responsiveness during peak usage with minimal loading times for ebook browsing and opening.
rationale: "Responsiveness", "peak usage" and "minimal loading times" have no measurable values.
clarification_questions: What counts as peak usage and as "minimal" loading time?
What response time is required for browsing and opening ebooks?

requirement_text: If the patient has never stored a security question or answer the user is asked for the random password assigned on creation of the account.
requirement_text_raw: If the patient has never stored a security question or answer  the user is asked for the random password assigned on creation of the account.
user_story: As a patient who never stored a security question, I want to be asked for the random password assigned when my account was created, so that I can still verify myself.
technical_task: When the patient has not stored a security question or answer, ask the user for the random password assigned at account creation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient who has never stored a security question or answer, when the user is verified, then the user is asked for the random password assigned on creation of the account.
Given a patient who has stored a security question and answer, when the user is verified, then the random password is not asked for.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: User shall be able to register or sign up, providing necessary information.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to register by providing the necessary information, so that I can use the application.
technical_task: Offer registration that collects the required information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the user provides the necessary information, then an account is created.
Given the registration form, when required information is missing, then registration is not completed.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. The necessary fields are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow publishers to publish data packages with cached resources on the registry server.
user_story: As a publisher, I want to publish data packages with cached resources on the registry server, so that others can access them.
technical_task: Allow publishers to publish data packages, including cached resources, to the registry server.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data package with cached resources, when the publisher publishes it, then it is available on the registry server.
Given a published data package, when it is retrieved, then its cached resources are included.
rationale: Role stated: publisher.

requirement_text: LOINC data from this file is added to a listing of allowable physical services (including laboratory procedures that an HCP can use).
user_story: As a clinic administrator, I want LOINC data from the file added to the listing of allowable physical services, so that HCPs can choose from them.
technical_task: Import the LOINC data from the file into the listing of allowable physical services, including laboratory procedures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file with LOINC data, when it is processed, then the data is added to the listing of allowable physical services.
Given the listing, when an HCP opens it, then the LOINC entries, including laboratory procedures, can be used.
rationale: Role assumed: clinic administrator.

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to Mange accounts.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage accounts, so that I can control who has access.
technical_task: Provide account management functions for admins.
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin, when the admin opens account management, then accounts are listed.
Given an account, when the admin changes it, then the change is saved.
rationale: Role stated: admin. The management actions are not listed.
